definitions.explanation: A grammatical unit of language expressing a complete thought.
One's share or the quantity for a specific purpose.

examples.japanese: この{文|ぶん}を{日本語|にほんご}に{訳|やく}してください。
examples.english: Please translate this sentence into Japanese.

examples.japanese: 3{人|にん}{分|ぶん}の{料理|りょうり}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered food for three people.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}の{一部分|いちぶぶん}を{貯金|ちょきん}する。
examples.english: I save a portion of my salary.

notes:
Has two distinct uses: grammatical sentence and portion/share.

MEANING 1 - SENTENCE:
・{文|ぶん}{法|ぽう} (grammar)
・{文|ぶん}{型|けい} (sentence pattern)
・{主|しゅ}{文|ぶん} (main clause)
・{複|ふく}{文|ぶん} (complex sentence)

MEANING 2 - PORTION/SHARE (as suffix):
・〜{人|にん}{分|ぶん} (for ~ people)
・{自分|じぶん}の{分|ぶん} (one's own share)
・{今日|きょう}の{分|ぶん} (today's portion)
・{余|あま}った{分|ぶん} (the leftover portion)

NOTE:
As a suffix meaning 'portion,' it often follows counters or nouns.
